summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on fraud/security, regulation.

articles.title: States keep targeting card fee relief
articles.description: Despite legal challenges to the Illinois Interchange Fee Prohibition Act, more than 30 interchange relief bills have been introduced in statehouses this year.

articles.title: Block to provide data to FTC
articles.description: The company said it will turn over documents the Federal Trade Commission sought in January in response to a probe of complaints about Square.

articles.title: Global Payments faces industry pricing pressure
articles.description: While analysts point to an increasingly competitive environment for the processor, the company is still trying to raise prices.

articles.title: How Barclays tucked into Samsung
articles.description: Twenty-plus years into card co-brands, Barclays’ newest launch – a card integrated into Samsung’s digital wallet – offers both new challenges and opportunities.

articles.title: BNPL for rent seeks a market
articles.description: A new crop of fintechs is exploring growth opportunities in pay-later lending for monthly rent payments as inflation pinches consumers.

articles.title: California takes CoinFlip to task
articles.description: The state ordered the crypto ATM company to pay $4.8 million to scam victims, and bashed federal regulators over failing to police for fraud.

articles.title: Shift4 signals caution
articles.description: The payments processor is navigating weak demand for travel to Europe, and softer sales at its restaurant and hotel customers.

articles.title: NCR Atleos, First Citizens lock arms
articles.description: The bank aims to expand its reach to more customers by offering services via the NCR Atleos ATMs in Target stores.
